title: Towers of Dalmatia
identity: Daniel Perttu identifies Towers of Dalmatia as an alto saxophone and piano work available through Dorn Publications. Westminster College announced its commission for saxophonist James Flowers and pianist Nancy DeSalvo.

evidence.claim: Composer lists the title under solo instrument and piano as an alto saxophone work and links Dorn Publications.
Westminster College announcement documents the premiere and dedicatees.

collection_flag: Original work commissioned for and premiered at a university by faculty performers; no young-player adaptation evidence.

score_links.description: Composer page links to Dorn edition.

gaps: Composer site does not provide a public score preview or recording on this page; score demands and duration remain unclear.
